# Jay Daftari

> Jay Daftari is a computer scientist and Gen AI engineer trained in AI and machine learning at New York University (MS, Computer Engineering). Jay builds agentic AI systems, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and LLM tooling, most recently for legal teams at Lina Law and Wequity.

Portfolio: https://jaydaftari.github.io/
Location: New York, NY, USA
Last updated: 2026-10-27

## Experience

- [Lina Law](https://www.lina.law/en), Forward Deployed Engineer (May 2026 to Oct 2026, remote): architected an MCP server with 60+ tools to read client emails, access case files, draft and review contracts using the firm's own Word templates, cutting turnaround from weeks to hours; orchestrated Claude-managed agent integration with a real-time collaborative legal document editor supporting concurrency, used daily by the firm's lawyers; led a Slack integration automating client intake, quoting, and initial drafts with AI agents while maintaining lawyer approval for every deliverable; built agent observability tooling that replays each AI run step by step (its reasoning and every tool call); engineered a GDPR-aligned PII redaction pipeline integrating rule-based detection, LLM-assisted redaction, lawyer-in-the-loop review, and pre-inference pseudonymization, enabling secure AI adoption for confidential legal matters.
- [Wequity](https://app.nora.legal), AI Engineer (Feb 2026 to May 2026, remote): built Nora's Smart Drafting engine on Claude Opus 4.6 (GPT-5.4 and Gemini 2.5 Pro fallbacks), auto-filling legal templates from client files with a cited source for every field; hardened the drafting pipeline (FastAPI, Cloud Run) with parallel extraction, per-file failure isolation and Slack alerts; cut first paint by 80% (12.2s to 2.4s) and raised Nora's Lighthouse performance score from 55 to 68; fixed Postgres bloat by moving to UUIDv7 keys and dropping 34 unused indexes.
- [Vicktoria AI](https://vicktoria.ai), Founding Engineer (Sep 2025 to Apr 2026, New York City): launched vicka.ai, a chat and voice AI coach, deploying a fine-tuned Mixture-of-Experts model with vLLM on RunPod GPUs, activating only 4B parameters per token; led the development of a RAG pipeline grounding responses in the founder's methodology (BGE embeddings, pgvector) with zero-downtime re-indexing; engineered a hands-free voice pipeline with self-hosted Kokoro TTS (Python, FastAPI) and sentence-level streaming playback; integrated real-time camera and photo inputs for multimodal AI interactions; automated CI/CD with GitHub Actions to AWS EC2 via OIDC and SSM; prototyped a talking-avatar service on Modal H100 GPUs with scale-to-zero inference.
- [NYC Department of Environmental Protection](https://www.nyc.gov/site/dep/index.page), Summer Graduate Intern (Jun 2025 to Aug 2025, New York City): re-engineered public-sector enterprise applications supporting contracts, procurement, and payment systems handling over $3 billion in annual transactions using Web Services, jQuery, ASP.NET, and VB.NET; utilized MS SQL Server, Python, Excel, Power BI, DAX Studio, and Report Viewer for end-to-end ETL processes, data analysis, and enterprise reporting.
- [New York University](https://engineering.nyu.edu/), Course Assistant (Jan 2025 to May 2025): open-source course development in Python and C++.
- [IDFC First Bank](https://www.idfcfirstbank.com), Application Engineer (Mar 2022 to Aug 2024, Bengaluru): React and React Native apps impacting 20M customers; UPI and video KYC features; 97% unit test coverage; Grafana and Prometheus monitoring.
- [VIT Center of Advanced Data Science](https://chennai.vit.ac.in/research/research-centre/centre-for-advanced-data-science/), Research Intern (Jul 2021 to Aug 2021, Chennai): explainable machine learning for water quality (90% accuracy, LIME and SHAP).
- [Premware Services India LLP](https://premware.services/), MEAN Stack Developer (Feb 2021 to Mar 2021, Surat): real-time backend for Surati Taxi.

## Selected projects

- [Auto Safety](https://github.com/jaydaftari/person-of-interest): an AI tool that watches live NYC traffic cameras and forecasts street risk (Next.js 15, RAPIDS)
- [MyNextDate](https://devpost.com/software/mynextdate) (Hacklytics 2026, team of four): a date planner that scores dates with an LLM (Llama 3.1 on Groq) and recommends the next one by vector similarity search (React, FastAPI, Actian Vector AI DB)
- [ML-Optimized Ad Blocker](https://github.com/jaydaftari/LLM-Based-AdBlocker) (co-built): a self-learning ad-blocking proxy that classifies new domains with an LLM (Llama 3.1 8B on Groq) and caches each verdict in a trie for microsecond lookups (Python, mitmproxy)
- [Shelclub](https://shelclub.vercel.app/): an editorial magazine platform with a writers' desk and an editor review workflow (Next.js 15, Payload CMS)
- [Efficient Hybrid Autoregressive Transformer](https://github.com/jaydaftari/hart-v2): a faster HART text-to-image generation pipeline (PyTorch, CUDA)
- [Gradient Analysis for Edge Deployment](https://github.com/jaydaftari/EfficientAI_Project): gradient statistics that guide pruning and gradient prediction (PyTorch)
- [Efficient Fine-Tuning of RoBERTa with LoRA](https://github.com/jaydaftari/DeepLearningProject2) (Python)
- [NYC MTA Ridership Dashboard](https://github.com/jaydaftari/CSGY-6513-Big-Data-Finals-Project): analytics and forecasting for 5+ years of NYC subway ridership (PySpark, Streamlit)
